output.explanation:
The central tree retains all five conceptual branches while shrinking from 93 to 61 lines (34.4%) and from 7,319 to 4,674 characters (36.1%). Five peripheral trees expand binding selection, mapped evidence, corpus boundaries, definition sessions and inspection state. [M] denotes modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership and [D] data dependency; [B] and [R] identify shared binding and corpus dependencies. Edges attach to the corresponding central concept lines. Tree dimensions and edge anchors were checked; positions leave nonoverlapping gaps.

Evidence comes only from the supplied point, seed and pinned source text. Binding detail follows diagramSource.ts; mapping identity and ordering follow codePanel.ts; access boundaries follow corpus.ts and projectSource.ts; lookup and lifetime detail follow projectLanguageService.ts; UI detail follows RepositoryFileExplorer.tsx and SourceCodeView.tsx. Added details include compatible binding replacement, hash-sensitive resource identity, keyboard navigation, LSP target normalization and the greater-than-240-row deferral threshold.

The seed's destination-selection description is narrowed: SourceCodeView selects only the first line of a multi-line destination, and restoration/activation guards affect when navigation runs. UTF-16 initialization accepts an omitted server encoding but rejects a different declared encoding. Session sharing is explicitly scoped to a service instance and canonical root. Returned definition targets undergo repository-path filtering, not the corpus provider's filesystem checks. Imported helper implementations and UI-to-service wiring are absent, so these trees do not infer their internal behavior or claim a verified end-to-end runtime trace.

Source Evidence and Navigation
|-- [M] Repository binding: resolveDiagramSource [B]
|   |-- Contract: project + optional representation/revision/content/source IDs + optional live diagram
|   |-- [C] loadProject -> require matching project ID -> resolve diagram
|   |   |-- Live diagram -> validate; require requested content ID to match
|   |   |-- Saved representation -> validate revision -> select exactly one diagram
|   |   `-- Source-only -> registered bindings + project.sources -> require one source
|   |-- Requested representation is validated even when a live diagram is supplied
|   |-- Requested sourceId must match the selected diagram's binding
|   `-- Exposes source query + diagram + binding() + readText() + listFiles()
|       `-- Reads/listings require explicit binding + injected CorpusAccess
|-- [M] Mapped evidence: domain handlers independent of React and file I/O
|   |-- Contract: handleNodeSelect, resolveSelectedNodes, buildSourceRangeDisplayModel
|   |-- [D] Selected diagram nodes + diagram mappings -> PanelContent
|   |   |-- Require sourceContext.contentHash == content.asciiSha256
|   |   |-- Index entries with a mapped node, entity and range
|   |   |   `-- Target = project/source + path + inclusive one-based lines + rangeSha256
|   |   |-- [C] Sort nodes in diagram order -> resolveSelectedNodes -> resolveNodeResources
|   |   `-- Deduplicate resources; retain origins, diagram/revision/hash and unmapped IDs
|   `-- [D] Ordered mappings -> source display sections
|       |-- Repository/file change or backward start line -> new file section
|       |-- Overlapping range -> extend previous range and retain contributing items
|       `-- Otherwise -> separate range; preserve diagram order
|-- [M] Source access: ProjectSourceService -> [B] -> corpus providers [R]
|   |-- files(project, directory, sourceId) -> resolved listFiles(directory)
|   |-- source(project, path, sourceId) -> resolved readText(path)
|   |   |-- Missing path or NUL-containing text -> error
|   |   `-- [D] Text -> {path, startLine: 1, lines, sourceSha256, lspEnabled}
|   `-- [M] Corpus boundary [R]: git-worktree or filesystem-documents
|       |-- Public: listDirectory, readLines, readDocumentLines/Text/Bytes
|       |-- Internal: canonical root + relative path; reject traversed symlinks
|       |-- Directory listing -> omit .git; directories first, then name/path order
|       `-- Range read -> validate inclusive one-based bounds; clip at document end
|-- [M] Optional definition navigation: injected LanguageService
|   |-- ProjectSourceService.definitions -> [B] -> language.definitions(binding.corpus, ...)
|   |   `-- No language service -> lsp-disabled error
|   |-- [D] Lookup needs corpus + path + position + displayed sourceSha256
|   |   |-- Require supported TS/JS repository path and nonnegative integer position
|   |   |-- [C] Read current text through [R] -> compute full-text SHA-256
|   |   |   |-- Hash mismatch -> ask caller to reload; no lookup
|   |   |   `-- Matching hash + position inside file -> use verified text
|   |   `-- Filter and deduplicate returned locations -> {locations, outsideRoot}
|   `-- [O] Each ProjectLanguageService owns sessions keyed by canonical root
|       |-- Same instance and root share one live session; missing/dead session replaced
|       |-- Session owns child process, RPC, serial request queue and idle timer
|       `-- Timeouts, failures, service disposal, exit and signals trigger cleanup
`-- [M] Source inspection UI: repository browser + read-only source viewer
    |-- RepositoryFileExplorer consumes CodeRepoService; emits onOpen(path)
    |   |-- [C] Expand directory -> load listing; select file -> invoke onOpen
    |   |-- [O] Listing promises shared per service, keyed by project/source/directory
    |   `-- Expansion/subscription state belongs to each directory instance
    `-- SourceCodeView consumes preview + range + presentation; emits callbacks
        |-- [D] Lines + path + theme -> tokens, with plain-text fallback
        |   `-- Lines + highlights + annotations + compaction metadata -> rows
        |-- Folded sections show a gap or supplied call-graph comments
        |   `-- Reveal section or graph-node lines; navigation expands destination section
        |-- [C] Ctrl/Meta-click or F12 -> DOM position -> onGoToDefinition(position)
        |   `-- Optional callback; view itself does not perform definition lookup
        |-- Navigation -> scroll; multi-line destination selects only its first line
        `-- [O] View owns token/fold state; optional scrollState retains offsets
            `-- Large unwrapped views can defer offscreen chunks of 80 rows

Explicit repository selection
|-- [C] resolveDiagramSource(store, ref, corpus?, liveDiagram?)
|   |-- Load project; reject missing project or mismatched project ID
|   |-- If representationId: load catalog before choosing live/saved branch
|   |   `-- revisionId ?? currentRevisionId must belong to representation.revisionIds
|   |-- Live: validateDiagram; check contentId if supplied
|   |-- Saved: sceneFromRevision -> filter scene contents
|   |   `-- With contentId: match ID; otherwise: require a source binding
|   |       `-- Exactly one candidate required
|   `-- Source-only: loadDiagramSourceBindings + project.sources
|       |-- Filter by sourceId when supplied; group by sourceId
|       |-- Same ID with different root, kind or repositoryIdentity -> reject
|       |-- Later compatible binding replaces earlier binding
|       `-- Exactly one distinct source -> synthetic source-query diagram
`-- [M] Query surface separates selection from access
    |-- Requested sourceId must equal selected binding.sourceId
    |-- Return diagramSource query + diagram + access closures
    |-- binding() rejects an absent repository binding
    `-- readText/listFiles -> binding() -> require CorpusAccess -> provider
        `-- Project identity alone does not establish a repository

Mapped evidence identity and ordering
|-- [D] sourceRangeIndex consumes diagram + projectId
|   |-- Reject stale diagram hash; skip entries missing node, entity or range
|   |-- sourceId = entity.sourceId ?? binding.sourceId ?? empty string
|   `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(originalLines joined with LF)
|       `-- Hash describes stored range text; this module does not reread disk
|-- [C] handleNodeSelect -> sort by line, then startColumn
|   |-- resolveSelectedNodes -> resolveNodeResources
|   |   `-- Matches carry selected/mapped nodes; helper also returns unmapped IDs
|   `-- Deduplicate by sourceResourceIdentity
|       |-- Identity: type + project + source + path + start/end + range hash
|       |-- Identical coordinates with different hashes remain distinct
|       `-- Append all origins; selectedNodeIds are deduplicated separately
|-- [D] buildSourceRangeDisplayModel consumes ordered resolved mappings
|   |-- Compare with last file and its last range
|   |-- Different project/source/path OR earlier start -> new section
|   |-- Otherwise start <= previous end -> extend end; append contributing item
|   `-- Otherwise append a separate range, including immediately adjacent ranges
`-- [M] mappedResourceHandlers registers source-range operations
    |-- Exposes index, identity and buildDisplayModel
    `-- Domain computes PanelContent; renderer wiring is outside supplied source

Corpus access boundary
|-- [M] corpusProvider(binding) selects a provider by binding.kind
|   `-- git-worktree and filesystem-documents use FilesystemCorpusProvider
|-- [C] Canonicalize root with realpath; require matching kind and directory
|   `-- Resolve relative path one segment at a time with lstat
|       |-- Reject absolute paths, backslashes, NUL, empty segments, '.' and '..'
|       |-- Empty whole path has zero segments and addresses the root
|       |-- Reject missing segments and symbolic links below canonical root
|       `-- Check resolved path stays within root; verify final target type
|-- [D] listDirectory -> entries
|   |-- Hide .git; symlink entries are classified as files
|   |   `-- Listing a symlink does not make it readable through this provider
|   `-- Sort directories first, then case-insensitive name, then path
`-- [C] readDocumentBytes -> readFile
    |-- readDocumentText -> UTF-8 decode; readDocumentLines -> split CRLF/LF
    |-- readLines -> validate integer bounds, start >= 1, end >= start
    |   `-- Slice from start - 1 through min(end, line count)
    `-- [D] ProjectSourceService.source hashes full text before returning lines
        `-- Full-text hash and mapped range hash cover different inputs

Definition lookup and session lifetime
|-- [D] Freshness gate before session lookup
|   |-- Validate repository path, TS/JS support and zero-based integer position
|   |-- Read current text -> require full-text SHA-256 match
|   `-- Require existing line; character may equal line.length
|-- [O] ProjectLanguageService instance owns Map<canonical root, session>
|   |-- Reuse live session or replace missing/dead entry
|   `-- Private LanguageSession owns process, RPC, queue and timers
|-- [C] Initialize -> require definition provider and UTF-16 compatibility
|   |-- Advertise UTF-16; reject a different declared position encoding
|   `-- workspace/applyEdit requests return applied: false
|-- [C] Queued lookup -> await ready -> check dead/abort -> didOpen(verified text)
|   |-- textDocument/definition uses cancellation token
|   |-- Finally: remove abort listener, dispose token, didClose if alive
|   |   `-- Outer finally schedules idle disposal
|   `-- Rejected request is caught on queue tail so later work can run
|-- [D] Normalize a single LSP result or array into locations
|   |-- Prefer targetUri over uri and targetSelectionRange over range
|   |-- Non-file URI or rejected repository-relative path -> outsideRoot++
|   |-- Deduplicate by serialized path + range
|   `-- Targets are not reread or realpath-checked here
`-- [O] Disposal is idempotent
    |-- Initialization or definition request exceeds 20 seconds -> reject + dispose
    |-- Five-minute idle timer, RPC error or child error/exit -> dispose
    |-- Remove from liveSessions; clear idle timer; dispose RPC
    |-- SIGTERM child PID on Windows, process group elsewhere
    |-- Service dispose -> dispose sessions, clear map, remove exit listener
    `-- Process exit calls service dispose; SIGINT/SIGTERM dispose liveSessions

Inspection interactions and retained state
|-- [O] RepositoryFileExplorer listing cache
|   |-- WeakMap keyed by CodeRepoService; map key = project/source/directory
|   |-- Cache promises; beyond 256 entries evict oldest insertion
|   |-- Failure evicts only if cached promise is still that failed request
|   |-- Refresh clears project keys across source IDs; bumps local generation
|   `-- Directory cleanup ignores late results; shared request continues
|-- [C] Explorer keyboard navigation across visible file/directory buttons
|   |-- Up/Down -> adjacent button; Home/End -> first/last
|   |-- Right -> expand a collapsed directory
|   `-- Left -> collapse expanded directory, otherwise focus parent button
|-- [D] SourceCodeView builds rows from supplied preview and metadata
|   |-- Only valid collapsed-comment sections fully inside preview are eligible
|   |-- Plain presentation skips tokenization; missing tokens use original text
|   |-- Annotations precede their line; highlightedRanges overrides default range
|   `-- Supplied graph comments reveal graph-node lines clipped to preview
|-- [O] Navigation and view state
|   |-- Source/compaction/navigation changes reset graph-node expansion
|   |   `-- Section expansion resets to sections containing navigation start
|   |-- active=false skips scroll restoration and destination selection effects
|   |-- New source identity -> prefer scrollState.read(), then initial offset
|   |   `-- Restored offset returns before normal target scrolling
|   |-- Otherwise scroll targetLine or range.startLine near top fifth of viewer
|   |-- Selection uses navigation start line + 1
|   |   `-- Multi-line range selects through end of its first line only
|   |-- Tokenization replacement reapplies selection when active and no initial offset
|   `-- Ignore obsolete token results and hidden-view zero scroll events
`-- [O] SourceCodeContent defers rendering work when enabled
    |-- Requires unwrapped view and more than 240 rendered rows
    |-- Group rows in chunks of 80; retain DOM for native search/selection
    |-- Measure width/height before setting contentVisibility=auto
    `-- ResizeObserver remeasures on width changes; disconnect on cleanup
